title: Tuning the charge distribution of Co–N–C active sites for enhanced trifunctional electrocatalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12524-12536
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00087H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhaopeng Sun, Yaling Wu, Yingying Chen, Zhibo Li, Sen Lei, Yongyong Cao, Lianwen Zhu, Xuebo Cao, Zheng Yan
In this work, Co2+/3+–N–C was synthesized via precise charge control. Co2+–N–C showed superior ORR, OER, HER performance. This work offers new strategies for MOF-derived electrocatalysts and clarifies the link between metal valence and activity.
